title: AI Context Manager Configuration
description: Configuration file for AI Context Manager handoff tool.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE autocompletion.

name.description: Project name. Auto-detected from package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, or folder name.

stack.description: Technology stack. Auto-detected, can be overridden.

description.description: Brief project description for the handoff context.

runtimeNotes.description: Optional notes about runtime or deployment environment.

environment.description: Optional environment and version details to help downstream tools avoid guessing APIs.

nextSteps.description: What needs to be done next, in priority order.

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last progress update. Auto-managed.

description.description: What you're currently working on mid-flight.

relevantFiles.description: Files the AI should focus on. Paths relative to project root.

steps.description: Optional ordered micro-steps for the active task to help new agents continue without replanning.

codeHints.description: Optional small code hints or signatures (1–3 lines each) that are especially important for the active task.

patterns.description: Key architectural patterns used (e.g., 'Repository pattern', 'Event sourcing').

constraints.description: Technical constraints the AI must respect.

protectedAreas.description: Optional areas or modules that should not be heavily refactored or changed without explicit instruction (e.g., 'auth core', 'billing').

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from file tree. Merged with built-in security exclusions.

maxTokens.description: Maximum token budget for the handoff file. Sections are truncated in priority order if exceeded.

format.description: Output format for the handoff file.

treeDepth.description: Maximum depth for file tree generation.

maxTreeEntries.description: Maximum number of entries in the file tree.

includeGit.description: Include git context (branch, recent commits, uncommitted changes).

gitLogCount.description: Number of recent git commits to include.

maxRelevantFiles.description: Suggested maximum number of relevant files a downstream agent should read immediately after the snapshot.

allowExtraReads.description: Whether downstream agents are allowed to read additional files beyond relevantFiles when strictly necessary.

readBudget.description: Hints for downstream tools about how aggressively they should read additional files to minimize token usage.
